mapper.sql: channel_api_id channelApiId, channel_id channelId, api_code apiCode, api_name apiName, description description, definition_json definitionJson, version version, created_by createdBy, updated_by updatedBy, create_time createTime, update_time updateTime
WHERE channel_id=#{channelId} AND (CONVERT(api_code USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '!' OR api_name LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '!')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_channel_api WHERE channel_id=#{channelId} AND api_code=#{code}
SELECT FROM t_channel_api WHERE channel_id=#{channelId} AND api_code=#{code} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM t_channel_api WHERE channel_id=#{channelId} ORDER BY api_code
SELECT FROM t_channel_api ORDER BY api_code, channel_api_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT api_code apiCode, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(definition_json, '$.transport.endpointCode')) endpointCode FROM t_channel_api WHERE channel_id=#{channelId} ORDER BY api_code
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_channel_api WHERE channel_api_id=#{row.channelApiId} AND version=#{row.version}
